Wear Pieces

280 combat pieces for the wearables from the 14 regions: footwear, backpack, coat and cloak, five designs each. Each piece is drawn from the real Puzzle Combat parts; the left picture is the item, the right one is the piece it grants. Value is the base; the game adds your stat, level/3 and rank (Lined +2, Fine +4 at the Tailor). Petals is the Tailor price of the Common rank (Lined x2, Fine x3).
